name: Oswald
source:
Otto's brother, who mysteriously disappeared ten years ago, after bringing a girl Bronwyn to the village.

[spoiler]In fact, he is only a half-brother to Otto, as his real father was the previous King of Byron, Darius.[/spoiler]
